breathStream.note: The dragon’s attack is a CONTINUOUS stream that must always reach its target. Assemble it, do not stretch a single cone: root at the maw, ceil((dist-28-19)/16) mid tiles, tip on the target face. All parts of one run share ONE frame index — that is what keeps the joins invisible; the pattern shifting frame to frame is the flow. A continuous stream needs no separate impact burst: the tip part IS the contact effect, so fire impact_burn once at onset at most.
breathStream.seamRule: same frame index across root, all mid tiles and tip

combatCoverage.heroEventPhaseRouting: source controller-derived body phases; effect choreography remains renderer-owned

compositor.renderKey: x,y followed by the 3x3 neighbourhood signatures tier:damage:stage (- when empty); frames keyed this way are reusable across scenes
codeOnly: drawWall masonry courses, timberFace, timberDeck, materialCollar

builder.frameIndexing: rows are zero-based d0..d7 in rowOrder; frames are one-based f1..; padding cells are never keyed

crop.column: sx = clamp(floor((wx - start) * sourceWidth / span), 0, sourceWidth - 1) with start = worldOriginTiles * tilePx and span = tilePx * worldTiles; rows identical
crop.artVersion2: opaque authored terrain everywhere, alpha forced to 255
crop.artVersion1: outside the plot: blend toward the realm color over edgeBlendPx plus deterministic grit (createGroundRaster, code)
crop.skirtDecor: same sprites and positions as before; tinted per realm only for artVersion 2

motionGlyphs.codeOnly: FantasyGroundMotion in apps/web/src/game/world/fantasyGround.ts draws realm-specific Graphics glyphs every motion.frameMs; not data

fantasy.catalogHashDerivation: sha256(JSON.stringify({worldId, columns, rows, tiles: [[tileId, realmId, allocation] in tileId order]}))
fantasy.catalogEncoding: regions[].runs and genesisRuns/seekerRuns are inclusive [start, end] tileId ranges; tileId = row * columns + column

tileMath.tileAt: x = floor(wrap(lon) / 360 * columns), y = min(rows - 1, floor((90 - lat) / 180 * rows)), tileId = y * columns + x

renderer.codeOnly: apps/web/src/ui/fantasy/runtime/*.mjs (CPU sphere raster, coastline/feature data) is not exported; the native globe is a separate port

regions.name: Frostveil
regions.lore: Beneath the blue ice, the bells of a buried kingdom still ring. Keepers of the last winter roads trade glacial crystal and guard ruins older than the Shattering.
regions.landscape: Ice shelves · frozen ridges · buried ruins
regions.settlementCopy: Packed snow, blue ice and frost-worn stone cover the full base ground. Frosted pines surround the same buildings and claim.
regions.settlementDetails: packed snow, blue ice, frost stone and frosted pines

regions.name: Elderwood
regions.lore: Strongholds vanish beneath a canopy of silver-root trees. Grove wardens read the land through its living roots; every felled tree carries a debt to the forest.
regions.landscape: Deep forest · ancient groves · green strongholds
regions.settlementCopy: Living moss, fern beds and woodland earth spread beneath the familiar buildings. Old-growth trees gather beyond the unchanged claim.
regions.settlementDetails: living moss, fern beds, woodland earth and old-growth trees

regions.name: Sunscar
regions.lore: A sea of amber dunes surrounds the shattered observatories. Caravan cities follow the shade of sandstone ridges, trading sun-glass and charts of vanished stars.
regions.landscape: Amber dunes · sandstone ridges · lost observatories
regions.settlementCopy: Wind-carved sand, sandstone and sun-glass cover the full base ground. A worn approach crosses the desert beneath the same buildings.

regions.name: Crownlands
regions.lore: Fields and ruined causeways bind the scattered crowns. No throne rules all these valleys, but their market roads carry the stories, seeds and ambitions of every realm.
regions.landscape: Rolling fields · river valleys · fallen watchtowers
regions.settlementCopy: Meadow turf, chalk gravel and worn earth form a temperate home beneath the same Keep and buildings. A trade road crosses the claim.
regions.settlementDetails: meadow turf, chalk gravel, worn earth and scattered trees

regions.name: Solana Reach
regions.lore: Violet terraces rise above sheltered mint-blue bays. Wandering beacon keepers follow crystal rivers to observatories built before the Shattering, carrying messages between distant shores.
regions.landscape: Violet terraces · crystal rivers · ancient beacons
regions.settlementCopy: Violet slate, crystal grass and mint seams extend across the full base ground. The same Keep stands among pale stone paths and crystal growths.
regions.settlementDetails: violet slate, crystal grass, mint seams and crystal growths

regions.name: Stormcairn
regions.lore: Storm-worn cairns mark the passes between green coastal terraces and a snowy northern range. Highland watchkeepers read the thunder before it reaches their sheltered harbors.
regions.landscape: Storm-weathered highlands · green coastal terraces · snowy northern range
regions.settlementCopy: Wet slate, silver heath and shallow rain pools cover the highland base. Storm-worn stones shelter the same Keep and unchanged claim.
regions.settlementDetails: wet slate, silver heath, rain pools and storm-worn stones

regions.name: Thornwake
regions.epithet: The jungle beyond the western sea
regions.lore: Waterfalls disappear into layers of fern and towering jungle. Old causeways lead between clearings where overgrown ruins still hold the marks of a seafaring kingdom.
regions.landscape: Layered jungle · fern clearings · waterfalls · overgrown ruins
regions.settlementCopy: Deep moss, braided roots and twilight ferns spread beneath the same buildings. Jungle growth gathers around the unchanged claim.
regions.settlementDetails: deep moss, braided roots, twilight ferns and jungle growth

regions.name: Cinderfall
regions.lore: Ochre ash drifts through weathered ruins beneath ridges of black obsidian. Hardy plants take root around sheltered springs, tracing the roads of the vanished furnace cities.
regions.landscape: Ochre ashlands · obsidian ridges · weathered ruins · hardy vegetation
regions.settlementCopy: Basalt ash, rust-red shale and ember seams cover the full base ground. Hardy plants and dark stone surround the same buildings.
regions.settlementDetails: basalt ash, rust-red shale, ember seams and hardy plants

chains.name: Glasswake Keys
chains.lore: Clear shoals hide drowned signal towers. Future expeditions may trace the forgotten sea road.

chains.name: Aurora Shoals
chains.lore: Pale islands catch the northern lights above silent harbors sealed by winter.

chains.name: Emberwake Isles
chains.lore: Ember-colored cliffs surround ash gardens and abandoned caravan landings.

chains.name: Whispering Skerries
chains.lore: Low stone islands shelter whispering ruins beyond the last charted shipping lane.

chains.name: Mintwake Atolls
chains.lore: Mint-bright streams descend through terraced timber groves to sheltered lagoons. Ruined landings mark the Reach’s old forest routes, where future expeditions could gather wood and trace the freshwater springs.
chains.landscape: Timber groves · mint lagoons · freshwater falls

chains.name: Prismforge Isles
chains.lore: Violet basalt shelves shelter thermal pools, exposed crystal seams and the silent remains of coastal forges. Future expeditions could investigate the mineral beds beneath these ancient workshops.
chains.landscape: Violet basalt · thermal pools · crystal seams

chains.name: Lumenreef Keys
chains.lore: Turquoise channels thread luminous reef gardens beneath weathered beacons. Tidal caves shelter rare growths, offering future explorers a quiet route between the Reach and the wider sea.
chains.landscape: Luminous groves · tidal caves · reef beacons
